# Scaffold

## Why this session exists

Connect equilibria to ideal and resistive linear-stability analysis.

::: {.notes}
[scaffold]

This deck is a scaffold, like its notebook. Session 05's content is developed
after session 04.

What it has to inherit when it is written: session 03's equilibrium and its
conventions, and session 04's distinction between a mode that was *measured* and
a mode that is *possible*. Session 04 closes by promising exactly that shift.
:::

## Session workflow

equilibrium $\rightarrow$ DCON/RDCON/GPEC $\rightarrow$ metric or mode
$\rightarrow$ physical interpretation

::: {.notes}
[scaffold]

No packaged VEST shot carries an `mhd_linear` IDS, so this session will have to
generate one by running a code in the notebook — as session 03 already does with
CHEASE. That feasibility question is the first thing to settle when the session
is written.
:::

## Practice goal

State which stability limit an equilibrium is near, and what would move it.

::: {.notes}
[scaffold]

Caution for whoever writes this: two functions in `vaft.formula.stability` look
like thresholds and carry docstring warnings that their coefficients are
unsourced heuristics. They must not be presented as validated limits.
:::
